description: This PHP source file defines the class 'BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel' within the OrangeHRM project. It models a data structure used to represent multiple employees and their leave entitlements, likely for API responses related to leave management.

classes.name: BulkLeaveEntitlementMatchingEmployeeModel
classes.description: Represents a model for bulk leave entitlement data linked to multiple employees, used for serialization and API responses.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with arrays of Employee and LeaveEntitlement objects and an optional entitlement float.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the model data into an array suitable for serialization, combining employee details with their entitlements.

methods.name: getEntitlementArrayWithEmpNumberAsKey
methods.description: Returns an associative array of entitlements keyed by employee number, raising an exception if multiple entitlements exist for the same employee.
